name: Survey Request
description: Ask customers for short feedback after a recent interaction.
html_content:
Got 60 seconds?

Hi {first_name},

We're constantly trying to make {company_name} better, and your feedback would mean a lot.

Could you take a minute to answer three quick questions?

Take the survey

That's it — no follow-up forms, no sales pitch. Just real answers from real customers.

Thanks for helping us improve.

— The {company_name} Team
